title: Cross-implementation feature and failure-mode review
mode: Current primary-source review plus local source, test-owner, and plan audit
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Compare local modeler/ACIS carrier paths with independent DWG and DXF implementations.
Reassess feature-matrix and class-maturity claims against object-level failure reports and documented unsupported paths.
Refine comparator independence, loss accounting, and implementation-ready gates without expanding feature claims.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source review and local source/test/plan reconciliation
localEvidence: dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp typed entity dispatch and output-loss reporting
Existing PAR-07/S8, PAR-138, LibreDWG/ACadSharp lineage, ezdxf, FreeCAD, and ACIS evidence sections in DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md
method.limitations: GitHub README/manual/issue pages are mutable and were not pinned to commits or executed artifacts in this pass. ACadSharp issue #1195 is a reporter account for its named peer route, not a local reproduction. LibreDWG's README, NEWS, and manual contain release/build-scoped claims and maturity categories; they do not qualify an arbitrary current-master artifact. ezdxf documentation scopes its own DXF and rendering/import routes. No source finding, support claim, native result, or universal format limit was inferred from peer statements.

libreDwg.route: Independent DWG implementation candidate with DXF conversion, broad version routing, and class-level stable/unstable/debugging/unhandled distinctions.
libreDwg.riskEvidence: Project documentation notes that advanced R2010+ objects can be skipped, later DWG writing has reported CRC limitations, some types lack test coverage, and historical R2013+ AcDs extraction was incomplete/brute-force.
libreDwg.useBoundary: Pin exact source, built artifact, options, version, direction, object, warnings, unknown/skipped disposition, and carrier bytes. A version claim or class maturity label does not prove object completeness, B-rep semantics, or native acceptance.

acadSharp.route: Independent DWG/DXF reader-writer candidate with a directional version matrix; its published matrix omits AC1021 DWG writing.
acadSharp.riskEvidence: Open #1195 reports 3DSOLID/REGION shells read from DWG but silently omitted in DXF output, without payload or loss notification; current issue index includes additional peer-specific parser/writer failure reports.
acadSharp.useBoundary: Treat version cells as routing only. Compare local identity, owner, block membership, typed shell, inline payload, AcDs records/keys/owners, emitted disposition, independent readback, and native outcome as separate fields. Peer thresholds are not format limits.

ezdxf.route: Independent DXF model/read-write and bounded ACIS carrier inspection; not a DWG reader or general ACIS kernel.
ezdxf.riskEvidence: XREF import ignores unsupported entities including ACAD_TABLE; documented renderer projects 3D into XY and does not render ACIS; ACIS payload authoring requires an external library.
ezdxf.useBoundary: Use only for a pinned DXF syntax/carrier question; record ignored objects and options. Do not treat transfer, rendering, or raw payload inspection as whole-document preservation or B-rep semantics.

localModelerRoute.route: Typed modeler entity dispatch plus profile-guarded raw SAT/SAB and AcDs-related carrier handling, with fail-closed refusal for unqualified target combinations.
existingOwners: PAR-07/S8 and existing FreeCAD composed consumer gates
localModelerRoute.evidenceCeiling: Local structure and carrier tests do not establish arbitrary ACIS validity, every AcDs join, editable 3D geometry, or native CAD acceptance.

lineage.deduplication: UnCAD's DWG route shares LibreDWG; ACadRust-based applications share a parser lineage; LibreCAD's bundled libdxfrw is a related fork. cq-acis has a distinct parser but uses the OpenCascade kernel family shared with FreeCAD.
lineage.consequence: Count distinct parser and geometry-kernel routes rather than wrappers/products, and do not let one route qualify another route's extraction, carrier association, semantics, or application acceptance.

existingOwners: existing LibreDWG, ACadSharp, ezdxf, ACIS, and FreeCAD comparator gates
